name: EmptyDaySeedSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue and empty days produce no placements
Plan_NoEmptyDays_YieldsNothing: all days have at least one occupied slot so nothing placed
Plan_FewerLessonsThanEmptyDays_PlacesOnePerEmptyDay: 2 lessons, 3 empty days => only 2 placed
Plan_MoreLessonsThanEmptyDays_PlacesOnePerEmptyDay: 10 lessons, 3 empty days => only 3 placed
Plan_AllDaysEmpty_PlacesOnePerDayTillQueueExhausted: 3 lessons, 5 fully empty days => 3 placed
Plan_AllDaysNonEmpty_YieldsNothing: no completely empty day found => nothing placed

name: FairShareSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue produces no placements
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAll: single subject fills all available slots
Plan_TwoSubjectsEqualProportions_AlternatesFairly: 50/50 split yields alternating pattern
Plan_TwoSubjectsUnequalProportions_ApproximatesRatio: 2:1 split yields Math,Math,Physics pattern
Plan_ThreeSubjectsProportional_MatchesDesiredDistribution: complex multi-subject proportional check
Plan_SubjectExhaustedInAvailable_SkippedGracefully: zero remaining subjects not picked
Plan_ProportionsAlignExactly_PerfectMatch: queue proportions exactly achievable slot count

name: LargestQueueFirstSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue returns nothing
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAllRemaining: single subject fills entire fillable pool
Plan_TwoSubjectsDifferentCounts_PicksLargerFirst: subject with larger remaining count picked first
Plan_MultipleSubjects_DescendingOrderByCount: subjects placed in descending remaining count order
Plan_Ties_PicksFirstByEnumerationOrder: equal counts returns first key in Available order

name: LeadingChunkGrowthSelector
tests: Plan_NoDaysWithPrecedingSpace_YieldsNothing: no day has space before first chunk
Plan_SingleDaySingleChunk_PlacesBeforeChunk: grows shortest chunk backwards by one slot
Plan_SingleDayMultiplePlacements_FillsBackwards: multiple placements fill slots before chunk sequentially
Plan_MultipleDays_ShortestChunkPlacedFirst: day with shorter first chunk gets placement first
Plan_QueueExhaustedMidPlacement_StopsEarly: fewer lessons than qualifying slots
Plan_FirstChunkAtSlot1_NoPlacement: chunk starts at slot 1 so no space before it
Plan_MultipleDaysTieByLength_OrderedByDate: equal chunk lengths tie-broken by date

name: RandomSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue returns nothing
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysReturnsThatSubject: single subject ignores randomness
Plan_SeededRandom_DeterministicOrder: same seed produces same sequence
Plan_DifferentSeed_ProducesDifferentOrder: different seed may produce different first pick
Plan_MultipleSubjects_SeededRandom_ConsistentSequence: full Plan() result deterministic with seed

name: RoundRobinSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue returns nothing
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysReturnsSameSubject: single subject fills all slots
Plan_TwoSubjects_AlternatesInOrder: Math,Physics,Math,Physics round-robin cycle
Plan_ThreeSubjects_CyclesInConstructionOrder: Math,Physics,Chem repeated cycle
Plan_SubjectExhaustedMidCycle_Skipped: exhausted subject skipped and remaining continue
Plan_UnevenCounts_DoesNotWrapToExhausted: correct cycle with subjects having different remaining counts

name: SmallestQueueFirstSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue returns nothing
Plan_SingleSubject_PlacesAllRemaining: single subject fills entire fillable pool
Plan_TwoSubjectsDifferentCounts_PicksSmallerFirst: subject with smaller remaining count picked first
Plan_MultipleSubjects_AscendingOrderByCount: subjects placed in ascending remaining count order
Plan_Ties_PicksFirstByEnumerationOrder: equal counts returns first key in Available order

name: TrailingChunkGrowthSelector
tests: Plan_NoDaysWithTrailingSpace_YieldsNothing: no day has space after last chunk
Plan_SingleDaySingleChunk_PlacesAfterChunk: grows shortest chunk forwards by one slot
Plan_SingleDayMultiplePlacements_FillsForwards: multiple placements fill slots after chunk sequentially
Plan_MultipleDays_ShortestChunkPlacedFirst: day with shorter last chunk gets placement first
Plan_QueueExhaustedMidPlacement_StopsEarly: fewer lessons than qualifying slots
Plan_LastChunkAtSlot6_NoPlacement: chunk ends at slotCount so no trailing space
Plan_MultipleDaysTieByLength_OrderedByDate: equal chunk lengths tie-broken by date

name: WeightedRandomSelector
tests: Plan_EmptyQueue_YieldsNothing: empty queue returns nothing
Plan_SingleSubject_AlwaysReturnsThatSubject: single subject ignores randomness
Plan_EqualWeights_SeededRandom_Deterministic: equal weights with seeded random gives deterministic sequence
Plan_UnequalWeights_HeavierMoreLikely: heavier subject picked first with seeded roll in its range
Plan_ZeroWeightSubject_NotPicked: subject with zero remaining is excluded from Available
Plan_SeededRandom_ProducesConsistentSequence: full Plan() result deterministic with seed
